title: Access evolution: staged launch backlog + evidence sampling notes
content:
Status: Draft — working notes for security + SRE-led staged launch of RBAC v2 and automated evidence sampling.

High-level intent:
- Replace brittle role matrices with attribute-centric access model (RBAC v2) while preserving forensic audit and SIEM-friendly telemetry.
- Provide a low-friction staged rollout path that surfaces evidence for compliance teams without blocking dev velocity.
- Automate evidence capture and export to SIEM with deterministic sampling so we have representative artifacts for audits.

Assumptions (call out):
- Customers and internal services can be mapped to attribute vectors (team, owner, env, sensitivity).
- Existing audit pipeline can accept additional fields (trace_id, decision_trace) without major infra changes.
- Storage for sampled evidence will be TTLed and encrypted via KMS.

Primary goals for staged launch:
1) Alpha (internal dev + platform team): live policy evaluation + debug logging. No enforcement, decisions logged only. Metrics: policy decision latency <= 10ms p99 for 95% of requests.
2) Beta (selected internal services + solutions-eng): enforcement on a small set of low-risk routes. Evidence sampling enabled at 100% for affected principals for first 48h, then 1% sample.
3) Canary (external customer pilot): enforcement for committed customers with opt-in; sampled evidence shipped to SIEM adapter and to a temporary audit bucket for compliance review.
4) GA: wide enforcement + evidence automation enabled with production sampling rules.

Sampling & evidence strategy (novel bits):
- Two-tier sampling: deterministic user-hash sampling for long-term trend visibility (percent by principal), and burst sampling for incidents/rollbacks (sliding window at route level).
- Evidence package = flattened audit event + policy decision graph (compact list of attributes considered + matched rules) + request metadata (route, model, input-hash) + ephemeral KV-cache snapshot id.
- Retention: sampled evidence stored for 90 days in encrypted bucket, with 30-day quick-access cache for compliance workflows.
- Access control: evidence buckets are accessible only to sec-compliance group and SRE-runbook role via short-lived credentials.

SIEM export contract (high-level):
- Events to emit: access_decision, evidence_sample_created, policy_diff_alert, rollback_triggered.
- Each event SHOULD include: timestamp, principal_id (anon-psuedo if external), action, resource_path, decision (allow/deny), decision_trace_id, policy_version, evaluation_latency_ms, sampling_type (deterministic|burst), evidence_ref (URI).
- Suggested field name normalization to avoid field explosion in SIEM: use short snake_case tokens, e.g., dec_trace, pol_v, eval_ms.

Sample flattened audit event (text example for reviewers):
- event_type: access_decision
- ts: 2025-02-12T16:12:03Z
- principal: user:gina.p (hashed: u_8a1f)
- action: infer:generate
- resource: model/llama-3b/route/chat-completion
- decision: deny
- decision_trace_id: dt_20250212_6a9c
- policy_version: v2.4.1
- eval_ms: 3
- sampling_type: deterministic(0.02)
- evidence_ref: s3://rbw-evidence/prod/2025-02-12/dt_20250212_6a9c.json

Evidence automation pipeline (steps):
1) Policy evaluation hook emits audit protobuf -> streaming layer (kafka topic: security.audit.v2).
2) Sampling service subscribes to topic, applies deterministic and burst rules, and writes evidence bundle to encrypted store.
3) Evidence-archiver indexes minimal metadata into search index (for compliance queries).
4) SIEM-adapter tails archive events and translates fields to SIEM normalized schema, batching at 1s windows.
5) Alerting rules in SIEM look for policy_diff_alert and unusual deny ratios.

Risk register (quick, working):
- Risk: Evidence store growth > budget. Mitigation: aggressive TTL + downsample older principals. Owner: Gina.
- Risk: Policy decision latency regressions impacting p99. Mitigation: local feature gates to disable decision graph capture; fallback to cached allow/deny. Owner: Ethan.
- Risk: SIEM schema mismatch causing missed alerts. Mitigation: small pilot with dedicated index + mapping migration plan. Owner: Priya.

Launch backlog (prioritized):
- CORE-1: Add decision_trace_id and policy_version to evaluation payload (SEC-5421) — ETA: 2 weeks (Ethan).
- CORE-2: Implement deterministic sampling by principal with config flag and rollout guard — ETA: 3 weeks (Liam).
- CORE-3: Evidence bundle schema v1 (flat fields + decision_graph text) — ETA: 2 weeks (Gina).
- CORE-4: SIEM adapter v0.1 with field remapping and test index — ETA: 4 weeks (Eng infra).
- CORE-5: Canary onboarding playbook + runbook for rollback — ETA: 1 week (Priya + SRE).

Operational signals to monitor during rollout:
- evaluation_latency_ms p50/p95/p99 by route
- sampled_evidence_write_errors rate
- evidence_store_size by day
- deny_rate_by_route and by principal cohort
- policy_change_rate and policy_diff_alert count

Rollback triggers (example):
- sudden >3x rise in eval p99 for any production route for 30m -> pause policy graph capture and revert to cached decisions.
- sampled evidence write error rate > 1% sustained for 10m -> stop burst sampling and page infra.
notes: These are working notes intended for collaboration with product, infra, and compliance. Expect iterations; this file consolidates the risk/backlog/sampling contract for the initial RBAC v2 staged launch.
